task.description: MANDATORY gate (this is a tenant-data-path change -- do not skip). ELIXIR-DEV implemented ISS-0768's fix (commit ddfa3cdf on this branch, feature/WF03-ISS0768-20260921, worktree c:\Users\tvolo\dev\ai-dala\letflow-wf03-iss0768 -- work there, do not touch c:\Users\tvolo\dev\ai-dala\letflow, a different concurrent session owns uncommitted work there on an unrelated issue): Letflow.Identity.RoleRegistry now threads opts :: [prefix: String.t()] through every Repo call (list_roles/1, upsert_role/3, do_upsert_role/3, insert_or_update_role/3), and lib/letflow/routers/identity.ex's handle_list_roles/2 and handle_upsert_role/2 pass conn.assigns.scoped_opts through. Gate this against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md's INV-1..INV-8, with INV-1 (tenant data isolation) as the primary concern -- this fix's entire purpose is closing a cross-tenant/wrong-schema leak (RoleRegistry was previously always querying the public schema regardless of caller tenant). Verify by DIRECT SOURCE READ (not by trusting ELIXIR-DEV's result.summary): every Repo call in role_registry.ex genuinely carries prefix: opts[:prefix] (or is inside a Repo.transaction opened with that prefix, per the design's defense-in-depth instruction to also name prefix: explicitly on each inner call); the router's scoped_opts is genuinely the caller's OWN tenant schema (not request-supplied, not defaulted) -- trace conn.assigns.scoped_opts back to where it's set (Letflow.Api.Context.scoped_repo_opts/1 per the router's own moduledoc) and confirm it cannot be influenced by request body/query data. Also verify resolve_role_in_tx/1 was left genuinely untouched (diff it yourself) -- confirm it does not become a live cross-tenant hole given it's unreachable today (state explicitly whether its continued absence of prefix threading is an acceptable residual risk given zero live callers, per the design's own reasoning). State a verdict per invariant (APPLIES/NOT-APPLICABLE) for every INV-1..INV-8, matching HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md's worked example shape. Hard rule: never push directly to main.
acceptance_criteria: Verdict stated for every INV-1..INV-8 (APPLIES with PASS/FAIL, or NOT-APPLICABLE with reason)
